development_oos_gates: maximum drawdown no worse than B1
edge per turnover at least B1
positive lower 95% bound for annualised mean-return delta versus B1
positive lower 95% bound for Sharpe delta versus B1

benchmarks.B0: hourly 2160H endpoint trend long/cash, next-open, 5 bps one way
benchmarks.B1: daily 00:00 UTC 2160H endpoint trend long/cash, next-open, 5 bps one way

feature.absorption_state: At a completed daily 00:00 UTC BTC bar t, locate the most recent absorptive shock aged 24-168 completed hours. State is true when log(close_t/close_u)>0 and min(low_(u+1)..low_t)>=low_u.
feature.sigma: 1.4826*MAD of the 168 completed BTC hourly log returns ending at u-1

hard_boundary.allowed: each target instrument's own lagged history plus frozen lagged BTC-USDT exogenous history mapping to that target's future long/cash decision
prohibited: accounts, orders, leverage or enabled adapters

policy.entry: At daily 00:00 UTC, enter from cash only when target close_t>close_(t-2160), common BTC absorption state is true and training support is enabled.
policy.exit: At daily 00:00 UTC, exit when target close_t<=close_(t-2160). Ignore BTC state while long.

support_rule.when_failed: candidate remains cash in both targets
